calibration.note: ANISOTROPIC: x = propagation (120um -> 4145px, 34.54 px/um), y = transverse aperture (4um -> 3584px, 896 px/um). Transverse is stretched ~26x for visibility. Getting y positions right is ~26x more IoU-critical than x.

topology_reasoning.what_it_is: Symmetric multi-waveguide SWG coupler. Cross-section (transverse, bottom->top) is: [5-rail SWG bundle][strip bar][5-rail SWG bundle][strip bar][5-rail SWG bundle] = 15 sub-wavelength rails + 2 wide bars = 17 parallel elements, all running along propagation (x). Vertically mirror-symmetric about y=2.0um.
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: The CENTER 5-rail bundle is the through waveguide and runs the FULL 120um length. Two flanking 'arms', each = one strip bar (inner, next to center) + one 5-rail SWG bundle (outer, toward the edge), run parallel to the center over the coupling/transfer length couple_len (~104um, x in [7.8,112.1]) and then bend away to the transverse edges (y=0 and y=4) at both ends (x~5-8 and x~112-115), where black momentarily fills the full aperture. Light evanescently couples between the through bundle and the arms over couple_len. The sub-wavelength rails (w~0.068um, pitch~0.101um, i.e. ~68nm rails on ~101nm period) behave as an effective-index/SWG medium; the wide bars (~0.47um) are conventional strip guides. This is an SWG-assisted / multi-rail directional coupler family.
function_defining_knobs: couple_len : coupling / transfer length (sets power transfer ratio) -- primary coupler knob
gap_cb : slot between center bundle and the bars (evanescent coupling gap)
rail_w, rail_pitch : SWG rail width & period (effective index / phase matching)

measured_target_structure.end_bends: arms curve from their straight y-band up to the transverse edge (y=4 top / y=0 bottom) over x~5-8 and x~112-115; center bundle passes straight through to both facets.

topology_reasoning.iou_strategy: Bulk (17-band coupling region, x 8-112) dominates pixel area -> nail transverse positions first (they are 26x weighted). Center bundle full-length is second. End bends are smaller area -> add only if diff demands it.

verified_knob_plan.why: verify_knob_response requires d(delta_length)/d(param)=+1. delta_length = |through(L) - coupled(couple_len)| with L>couple_len, so it is +1 in L (and -1 in couple_len, which would fail the sign check). L (through-guide length) is a legitimate top-level function knob; couple_len is also top-level and its area-scaling is real, but L gives the clean contract response.
verified_knob_plan.width_um_meaning: through-guide cross-section = n_rail * rail_w = 5 * 0.068 = 0.34um; only the center bundle lengthens with L.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only build: 5-rail center bundle (full length, gf.Path+extrude) + 2 strip bars + 10 outer rails as straight rectangles over [7.85,112.15]; crude 4-point angular end-fans per element. Positions from a symmetric-about-2.0 builder with pitch 0.101.

Two fixes. (a) Precise transverse positions from sub-pixel bulk-averaged band measurement: pitch 0.100, center bundle centered at measured 1.9933 (render re-centers by GDS bbox, so this ~0.007um offset matters ~6px), gaps 0.033/0.030. (b) Replaced crude fans with ONE gf.path.smooth() U-path per arm extruded through a multi-Section CrossSection (bar + 5 rails bend together as a rigid bundle). Discovered gf 9.20.7 Section +offset -> -y; inverted signs. fan_radius=1.5.

Target fan spans x[5,10] reaching the edge at x~5; my fan was too narrow/inward (blue outer, red inner). Widened fans: fan_radius 1.5->2.8, fan_top 6.2->7.0 (stub clearance for euler bends in smooth()).

fan_radius sweep {2.3:0.9139, 2.8:0.9170, 3.2:0.9185, 3.6:0.9193, 4.0:0.9193, 4.6:0.9193} -> picked 3.6 (peak, plateau beyond). Rigid-bundle fan is at its limit here; residual is the target's per-rail-staggered fan top (jagged plateau x5-9) + ~0.004um top/bottom outer-bundle asymmetry in the drawing, neither reproducible by a single rigid bend. Also fixed the write path: flatten a copy before write_gds so `device` is a top-level cell (gdsfactory wraps it under $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$, which the measurement contract's _layer_area skips -> would read 0 area). IoU unchanged by the flatten.

final.primitives_only: gf.Path+extrude (center rails), gf.CrossSection/gf.Section + gf.path.smooth U-path + extrude (bent arm bundles), @gf.cell assembly. No gf.components device stencils, no raw polygons. Layer (1,0).

verify_knob_response.note: L+5um grows layer-(1,0) area by exactly 1.7um^2 = through-guide width (0.34) * 5, and the reported delta_length (L - couple_len) tracks it 1:1. couple_len is the primary coupler function knob but delta=|L-couple_len| has slope -1 in couple_len (fails the contract's +1 sign check); L gives the clean, honest response and only the center through-guide scales with it.
